react.initialize: useWorld(capacity, setup); manual worlds need await warmUpEngine() first

reactNative.surface: Development or store build; not Expo Go (guard with isEngineAvailable)
reactNative.assets: Metro require(...) or URI strings; add glb/gltf to Metro assetExts
reactNative.frames: Display clock drives GameView; a native render thread draws, JS never waits on the GPU
reactNative.android: minSdkVersion 26, VIBRATE permission; SurfaceView screenshots need captureScreen(..., { handleGLSurfaceViewOnAndroid: true })

fileStructure.game.ts: createGame(world, onHud, onEnd): rules, start/stop/reset/update/tap/dispose; no UI imports
fileStructure.useGame.ts: useWorld(capacity, setup) calling createGame; setup returns game.dispose

lifecycleRules: Own worlds with useWorld(capacity, setup); never create one in render, useMemo or module scope.
GameView steps the world right after onUpdate. Never write onUpdate={dt => world.update(dt)}; call world.update only to step differently (GameView then skips its step).
world.update flushes world.transforms first; flush() only to read back in the same frame.
Check world.isDisposed, not a custom flag. After dispose, cleanup calls and queries are no-ops; spawn, update and effects throw.
workflow: Rules in a shared factory; useWorld setup creates it.
Input and rules in onUpdate; per-frame moves on world.transforms.
React state only for HUD values, via world.scoreboard.listen.
Reset: cancelTimers, despawn round actors, scoreboard.reset. Report one result per run.
Pause with GameView paused. Load assets and build meshes outside the frame loop; slice long setup with afterNextFrame.

api.create: useWorld(capacity, setup?, deps?, onError?) -> World | null
api.step: Automatic after onUpdate; world.updateCount counts steps
api.moveEveryFrame: world.transforms.position(e, x, y, z) | rotation(e, qx, qy, qz, qw) | scale(e, x, y?, z?) | color(e, r, g, b, a?) | transform(e, x, y, z, qx, qy, qz, qw)
api.rotate: quat.y | x | z | axisAngle | fromEuler | multiply | slerp | identity; optional out
api.queriesWithOut: position | worldPosition | velocity (e, out); raycast(origin, dir, max, mask?, out?); pick(x, y, out?); toScreen(p, out?); screenToWorld(x, y, plane?, out?)
api.screenQueriesBeforeFirstFrame: toScreen and screenToWorld return null before the first frame
api.collision: world.forEachCollision((a, b, { started, sensor, speed }) => ...) in onUpdate
api.animate: await world.animate(e, { position, rotation, scale, color, moveBy, turn, shake }, { duration, easing, repeat, yoyo, spring })
api.effects: effects.confetti | sparkle | shatter | splash | sparks | explosion(world, EffectOptions); dust(world, DustOptions); flash(world, FlashOptions)
api.effectOptions: { position, colors, size, speed, count, lifetime, gravity?, direction?, spread?, flash? }
api.popClearedPiece: await effects.pop(world, e, { scale, color? }); world.despawn(e)
api.glowColors: effects.hot(color, peak?, alpha?); effects.pale(color, t, alpha?)
api.meshLimit: MAX_MESHES = 4096, never freed: build meshes once
api.colors: CSS strings ('#33B3FF', 'rgba(...)', transparent/black/white/red/green/blue/yellow/orange/purple/gray) or 0..1 tuples; vertex colors are tuples; toColor(css)
api.assetSource: string | number (URL on web, require(...) on native)
api.types: GameViewProps, GameViewStats, JoystickProps, AssetSource, AudioPlayOptions, ClipOptions, ScreenPlane, GeometryPart, EffectOptions, DustOptions, FlashOptions, PopOptions, MutableQuat, TransformBatch, DrawingStroke, DrawingSample, DrawingCoverageOptions
api.path: new Path().addRoundedRect(x, y, w, h, r) | addStar(cx, cy, outer, inner, points?) | quadraticTo | toContours
api.scoreboardUi: const unlisten = world.scoreboard.listen({ onScore, onSecond, onLives })
api.skeletal: loadModel(src).animations; world.playClip(e, name, { loop?, speed?, fade?, time? }); world.stopClip(e, reset?)
api.frameStats: <GameView onStats={({ fps, updateMs, renderMs, quality, backend }) => ...} />

drawing.create: new DrawingDocument(width, height, pixelRatio?) after warm-up, one per screen
drawing.tools: doc.setBrush({ brushType, color, width, opacity, ... }); updateControls; undo / redo / clear
drawing.saveLoad: exportProject / load; exportSVG; snapshot() -> { base64, width, height }; captureDraft(revision)
drawing.gameInput: doc.input(phase 0..3, x, y, pressure, 'document'); always end or cancel a stroke
drawing.coverage: doc.coverage({ x, y, width, height, minAlpha }) -> 0..1
drawing.lifecycle: clear() on replay; dispose() on unmount after the world; a disposed document throws (doc.isDisposed)

neverDo: new World in render, useMemo or module scope.
onUpdate={dt => world.update(dt)}, requestAnimationFrame or setInterval loops.
Meshes per spawn or per frame.
Drawing still scenery live every frame (still: true, world.backdropLayer).
Moving the camera every frame over a still backdrop.
Invented API names; check the reference.

distinctions.entity: Handle to one object in one World
distinctions.model: Reusable mesh; spawn entities from it
distinctions.pause: GameView paused: no steps, same world
distinctions.reset: Your function preparing a fresh round
distinctions.coordinates: Y up; ground is X/Z; input in view points
distinctions.rotation: Quaternion [x, y, z, w] from quat; radians

verification: Errors are visible; the view has a real size.
Start, score, win, lose, stop, replay and unmount work; one result per run.
Web runs over localhost or HTTPS.
Claim native behavior only after a development build ran.

performance.zeroAllocation: out arguments, quat out, world.transforms setters
performance.batching: world.transforms applies in one native call per step
performance.web: Renderer reads WASM buffers in place
performance.frames: Native: display clock, render thread; stale frames are replaced, not queued
performance.culling: Frustum culling in Rust every frame; skinned meshes never culled
performance.loading: Assets decode on native background threads
performance.quality: quality='auto' drops shadow filtering, then shadows and anti-aliasing, then resolution, only while drawing can't keep up; qualityKey remembers the level per game; adaptQuality={false} on ready screens, menus and results
performance.backdrop: Still scenery (still: true or world.backdropLayer, stepped once with update(0)) is drawn once into a cached image and redrawn only when the layer steps or the camera, light, size or quality change
performance.lod: Native: static meshes of 1,500+ triangles get automatic LOD within half a pixel; skinned and two-sided (leaf/card) meshes stay whole; the web draws full meshes
performance.bake: bakeModel draws camera-facing models (tiles, icons) once into a picture shown on a plane; key + isBakeKept restore it without building the models

caching.automatic: Rust caches prepared meshes and asset bytes
caching.persistence: No TTL; app-private storage on native, IndexedDB on web
caching.ownership: New World per scene; loaded assets stay valid
caching.advanced: ProceduralCache(revision) for expensive deterministic factories; one revision per game
caching.gamesIntegration: @nayan-ui/games loaders await engine warm-up; no expo-file-system needed

assetLoading.initialize: loadModel, loadTexture, loadFont and audio.load warm the core up themselves
assetLoading.errors: Loaders reject with the API name, source and cause; failed sounds are skipped
assetLoading.ownership: Loaded handles are session-wide; each scene disposes its own World
